notes: The Redevelopment Agency's acquisition appraisals for Western Addition A-2 by Maury Holmes, real estate appraiser: SFH371-5001 to 5012 (1962, by blocks) and SFH371-5013 (the first acquisition appraisal report, cover letter 20 January 1964). Each 1962 sheet gives the property address, parcel number, zoning, present use, assessed value, land dimension, the improvements' condition, effective age and a typed description, and the land and improvement values summing to a market value. The 1964 sheets give present use and building area instead of a description. Sheets were parsed from the OCR and matched to parcels by parcel number or address; every sheet that reaches an existing page was read by eye from the page image. Owners, acquisition dates, incomes and occupancy are not transcribed.

coverage.remaining: Of 1,188 sheets in 5001 to 5013, 494 resolved to a parcel and 263 of those to a building the roll dates before 1962; 117 reach an existing page and were read from the images (15 of them land on a different building or a renumbered lot that does not fit, and are left out). The other standing parcels with no page (about 146) are not hand-read; three that fit their parcel plainly are held. The later appraisal volumes, 5014 to 5019 and 5024 to 5029, are not read. Scripts and hand transcriptions are in /mnt/project-files/sfra-acquisition-appraisals/.
coverage.note: Appraisals are dated by the volume (1962) or the cover letter (20 January 1964). Effective age is not given as a year.
